propositions: The gate ref must migrate from mode-only to an additive dual-format blob that retains gated_mode: reconcile-check while adding paused, reason, who, and paused_at fields, such that pre-change decoders accept every new blob without breaking old binaries.
Pause and resume operations must preserve the existing expected-old-oid CAS mechanism; rejected CAS surfaces clean conflict with re-read remote state; no blind retry or overwrite occurs.

A new paused gate blocks mutating reconciler modes as a benign exit 0 with exactly one stderr line conforming to BRIDGE_PAUSED: JSON format, while reconcile-check preserves its pre-gate early return and remains allowed.

Corrupt remote gate blobs must exit 1 with a stable recovery line without traceback, move the mutating-mode gate read inside the protected path, and clear via clear_gate by observed oid without decoding the blob.

The rebar bridge pause subcommand requires nonblank reason, uses repository git user.email as who (refusing without writing if missing), generates paused_at in UTC RFC3339 only on first pause, and is idempotent only when reason matches exactly.

The scheduled workflow commit-and-push step must be skipped when paused=true and must recognize only complete BRIDGE_PAUSED: marker lines with valid four-key JSON, preserving all existing rc mappings for legacy gate and corrupt outcomes.
